body:
maria (docs): Heads-up — I opened PR #4021 for the SDK v2 migration guide + landing page updates. Want to align merge timing with next release so the preview matches the build. preview: https://deploy-preview-4021--docs.redwood.run

tyler (eng): Thanks. Is anything in that PR dependent on the feature-flag rollout?

maria (docs): Not technically required, but there are code samples that reference the new flag names. We can keep the snippets behind a note, or update them post-merge. Prefer to merge before release cut if CI is green.

ashok (release): Cutoff for the release train is Thu 09:00 UTC. After that we only accept emergencies. If you need it in the release, merge before cutoff and coordinate with me for the canary.

ken (pm): Team, this migration guide should go out with the release — customers waiting. If merge happens before cutoff, we need a docs preview link added to the release notes.

ci-bot: CI status for PR #4021 — checks: build ✅, lint ✅, deploy-preview ✅ (staging), link-checker: failed on one external link "docs.example.com/old-path"

maria (docs): On the link-check failure — I pushed a tiny fix (redirects) in branch. Will re-run. Also added an SDK snippet for python client (v2) but kept the old snippet commented so we don't break existing users.

julia (devex): Quick QA note — migration examples should include the minimal auth snippet, right now the python sample omits token example. Small but important.

tyler (eng): I can add the token snippet. Will PR to the branch by EOD. No runtime changes.

maria (docs): Great — @tyler please put it as an optional callout so it doesn't read like a mandatory change. Also updated the headings to versioned docs path: /docs/v2/migration — make sure that aligns with routing.

ashok (release): If you want the docs to land with the release, finalize by Wed 22:00 UTC to give SRE and release engineers time to bake canaries. Otherwise we'll aim for next patch.

ci-bot: Re-run complete — link-checker ✅, accessibility check ✅, deploy-preview updated: https://deploy-preview-4021--docs.redwood.run (staging)

ken (pm): Looks good from product side. Approving once tyler's snippet is in. Can someone ping me when merged so I can add to release notes?

maria (docs): Will do. Requesting review: @julia (devex), @tyler (eng), @ashok (release).

julia (devex): :eyes: Reviewing now, small nit on heading levels.

tyler (eng): PR out with token snippet, added fenced code block:
```python
from redwood import Client
client = Client(api_key="<YOUR_KEY>")
```

maria (docs): Thanks. Addressed julia's nit and pushed. CI is green.

julia (devex): Approved.

tyler (eng): Approved.

maria (docs): All approvals in — merging now. @ashok please confirm we can include the docs preview link in release notes.

ashok (release): Confirmed. Include preview link and call out migration steps under Breaking Changes. Scheduling canary for Thu 02:00 UTC.

maria (docs): Merged and added preview link to the release notes draft. Thanks everyone! :tada:

ken (pm): Awesome. I'll draft customer comms referencing the migration guide. Please send me any specific phrasing you want included.

maria (docs): Sending a short summary in a follow-up DM. If anything else pops up, please mention this thread.

ci-bot: Deployment to prod docs site scheduled with release.
